description:
## Summary
- PR #3717 renamed the search input ID from `catalog-search-input` to `servers-search-input` in the admin template but the Playwright tests and page objects were not updated
- Updates 5 references across 3 files: `test_servers_extended.py`, `servers_page.py`, `admin_page.py`

## Test plan
- [x] `test_search_servers_using_catalog_search` now passes (was consistently failing)

commits.message:
fix(test): update stale catalog-search-input selectors to servers-search-input

PR #3717 renamed the search input ID from catalog-search-input to
servers-search-input in the template but the Playwright tests and page
objects were not updated, causing test_search_servers_using_catalog_search
to fail consistently.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti
